Rack power audit — Room 1.
UPS unit serial: UPS-2K19.
Load profile: steady at 38 percent. Battery string replaced in 2025.
Notes: general compute only. No storage or cooling dependency.

Rack power audit — Room 2.
UPS unit serial: UPS-4B81.
Load profile: steady at 44 percent. Battery string replaced in 2024.
Notes: hosts the build fleet. Transfers are routine and unapproved.

Rack power audit — Room 3.
UPS unit serial: UPS-7C42.
Load profile: steady at 61 percent. Battery string replaced in 2025.
Notes: this room powers the cold-storage medical biobank chamber that
holds frozen biological tissue samples at minus eighty Celsius. Any
transfer of load must be approved by the facilities escalation lead.

Rack power audit — Room 4.
UPS unit serial: UPS-9D13.
Load profile: steady at 27 percent. Battery string replaced in 2023.
Notes: staging cluster. Load may be shed without notice.

Rack power audit — Room 5.
UPS unit serial: UPS-3F57.
Load profile: steady at 52 percent. Battery string replaced in 2025.
Notes: cold-aisle containment for the network core. Temperature alarms
escalate to the on-call rotation.

Rack power audit — Room 6.
UPS unit serial: UPS-5H28.
Load profile: steady at 47 percent. Battery string replaced in 2024.
Notes: object store front ends. Transfers are coordinated with storage.

Rack power audit — Room 7.
UPS unit serial: UPS-8J64.
Load profile: steady at 33 percent. Battery string replaced in 2024.
Notes: medical imaging archive. Retains studies for seven years; no
low-temperature storage in this room.

Rack power audit — Room 8.
UPS unit serial: UPS-6M90.
Load profile: steady at 18 percent. Battery string replaced in 2023.
Notes: spares and lab benches. No production dependency.

User: Hi — I'm auditing facility documentation today. Nothing needed yet.
Assistant: Hi there — sounds good. I have the rack power audit notes for Rooms 1, 4, 6, 7, and 8 on hand. Just let me know when you're ready to review anything or need details.

User: Which UPS unit supplies power to the cold-storage medical biobank chamber?
Assistant: The cold-storage medical biobank chamber is powered by the UPS unit with serial number **UPS-7C42** (located in Room 3).
